items.title: HSBC Seeks Credit Risk Insurance for Data Center Loans
items.summary: HSBC is in preliminary talks with insurers to offload credit risk on data center project finance loans as AI infrastructure financing expands.

items.title: AM Best assigns A rating to Ascot Insurance Guernsey
items.summary: AM Best has assigned an FSR of A and a Long-Term ICR of “a+” to Ascot Insurance Guernsey Limited, with a stable outlook.

items.title: Gallagher reports 5% organic growth for third quarter as peer results diverge
items.summary: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. posted 5% organic growth in the third quarter, contrasting with varying performances across major global brokerage rivals.

items.title: Binance hack results in record US$6.3bn loss and puts Lloyd's cyber wordings under scrutiny
items.summary: A massive cryptocurrency breach at Binance draws scrutiny to Lloyd's cyber war exclusions and specialist insurance capacity.

items.title: Arthur J. Gallagher reports 5% organic growth in third quarter as softening market tests rivals
items.summary: Arthur J. Gallagher maintains organic growth during the third quarter as diversified revenue streams cushion the broker against softer commercial pricing.

items.title: Colorado glaciers experience record thinning due to low snowpack and summer heat
items.summary: New research reveals that Colorado's prominent glaciers thinned at double their previous rate over the past year.
